title: Nick Sirianni: Jalen Hurts' health is our concern, not going to get into details

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nick Sirianni: Jalen Hurts' health is our concern, not going to get into details
sources.description: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni repeatedly declined to discuss quarterback Jalen Hurts' health today, a day after the Eagles announced that Hurts will miss Sunday's game because of a blood clot.
